title: Dua for entering the mosque
meaning: O Allah, open for me the doors of Your mercy.

title: Dua for leaving the mosque
meaning: O Allah, I ask You of Your bounty.

title: Dua-e-Qunut
text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْتَعِينُكَ وَنَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَنُؤْمِنُ بِكَ وَنَتَوَكَّلُ عَلَيْكَ وَنُثْنِي عَلَيْكَ الْخَيْرَ وَنَشْكُرُكَ وَلاَ نَكْفُرُكَ وَنَخْلَعُ وَنَتْرُكُ مَنْ يَفْجُرُكَ اللَّهُمَّ إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَلَكَ نُصَلِّي وَنَسْجُدُ وَإِلَيْكَ نَسْعَى وَنَحْفِدُ وَنَرْجُو رَحْمَتَكَ وَنَخْشَى عَذَابَكَ إِنَّ عَذَابَكَ بِالْكُفَّارِ مُلْحِقٌ
meaning: O Allah, we seek Your help and ask Your forgiveness, and we believe in You and rely on You, and we praise You in the best manner, and we thank You and we are not ungrateful to You, and we cast off and leave him who disobeys You. O Allah, You alone we worship, and to You we pray and prostrate, and to You we run and hasten, and we hope for Your mercy, and we fear Your punishment, for Your punishment surely overtakes the disbelievers.
